title: 第11章 人质第12章 心理战术
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
而张三在给了这微胖男孩胯下要害一招致命打击后，就算对方疼得两眼上翻也没就此打住，在其双手护裆之时，张三的双手已经抓住了他的左腿，然后再用力一抬。
由于这微胖男孩本就在奔跑冲刺的状态，所以其双脚都是虚浮的，下盘本就不稳，现在被张三抬起一腿，自然是直接失去平衡。
再加上他这边还没从下身那触电般的痛感中缓过劲来，更是没有半点余力去维持自己的平衡。
“诶！王虎你？”
在这微胖男孩向右栽倒之时，紧跟在其右侧的武魂为梅花豹的矮瘦男孩直接和其撞在了一块，一起失去了平衡栽倒在地。
这样一来，在这两人缓过劲来之前，张三要应对的自然就只有左侧武魂为灰刀豺狼的男孩了。
他在将微胖男孩绊倒在地之后，继续保持弯着腰的姿势向下一个“受害者”直径撞去。
“呃！唔！”
这个高瘦的男孩在见张三这样向自己撞来时也有点慌神，毕竟他这边是打算等微胖男孩将张三抱住后，再上去揍张三的，并没有直接和张三对上的想法。
不过这高瘦男孩也是机灵，他见张三前面对微胖男孩用了招猴子偷桃，就直接将其撂倒，自然是将双手先架在身前去防范张三故技重施。
而且只要他这边成功拖住张三，那么另外两人起身后，必然就能对张三展开夹击，到时候一样不是没有击败张三的可能。
但是张三这边却是弯着腰冲过来，而且他冲刺的速度极快，在这高瘦男孩抬手时，距离对方也就不到半尺了。
高瘦男孩只好双手成爪，想要抓住张三的衣服或者头发，让他停住。
可是张三却双腿一沉半跪在地上，再次变换高度，让高瘦男孩刚刚准备好的攻击落在空处，然后他将两手摁在对方的大腿上，再往后一推，让刚刚才停下也一样未站稳脚跟的高瘦男孩向后倒去。
不过这高瘦男孩也没直接倒下，他这边双手在两旁像是鸭子一样乱晃两下，可算是找回了平衡。
然而这高瘦男孩没想到在这时候张三已经站起来了，并且还直接伸过手来抓住他那伸长的右手，来了个过肩摔。
当然说是“过肩摔”也不太恰当，张三这边没有用那么大的气力，而是借助对方为防止他自己后倒而使用的向前倾的力量，将他向前甩去。
“让、让开啊！”
这下这个高瘦男孩就真的防不住了，他向前踉踉跄跄的栽去，而他的路径上正是他那两个正要爬起身来的同伴。
“一起过去吧！”

就在这高瘦男孩还想要努力控制好平衡之时，张三眉梢一挑，对着他的屁股就是一脚。
“唔啊！”
结果可想而知，三人一同发出一声惨叫，就这么倒在了一起。
当然这三人都是兽武魂，而且还都在武魂附体的状态，所以虽然倒地后被摔得七荤八素，但实际上也没失去战力，只要爬起来他们还是可以和张三一较高下的。
可是张三哪里会给他们这个机会？
面对各有动作的三人，张三快步上前，对着要起来的高瘦男孩的后背就是一脚，将他直接给踩了回去。
而另一个梅花豹武魂的矮弱男孩想要翻身出逃，还没翻过身来，脑袋就吃了张三一拳，被打得眼冒金星。
而那个被高瘦男孩压着的微胖男孩则已经缓过劲来，趴在地上的他想效仿张三去扯张三的脚，给自己的同伴创造反攻的机会。
content_en:
After Zhang San gave the fat boy a fatal blow to his crotch, he didn't stop even if the opponent's eyes rolled up in pain. When Zhang San was protecting his crotch with both hands, Zhang San's hands had already grabbed his left leg, and then he lifted it up hard.
Since this fat boy was already running and sprinting, his feet were floating and his lower body was already unstable. Now that Zhang San lifted one leg, he naturally lost his balance.
In addition, he had not yet recovered from the electric shock-like pain in his lower body, and he had no energy left to maintain his balance.
"Hey! Wang Hu, you?"
When the fat boy fell to the right, the short and skinny boy with the martial spirit of Meihua Leopard who followed immediately on his right collided with him, losing his balance and falling to the ground.
In this way, before these two people calm down, the only one Zhang San has to deal with is the boy on the left whose martial spirit is Gray Blade Jackal.
After tripping the fat boy to the ground, he continued to keep his bent posture and hit the next "victim".
"Uh! Uh!"
This tall and thin boy was a little panicked when he saw Zhang San bumping into him like this. After all, he planned to wait for the fat boy to hug Zhang San before going up to beat Zhang San. He had no intention of confronting Zhang San directly.
However, this tall and thin boy was also smart. When he saw Zhang San using the monkey trick on the fat boy before, he knocked him down. Naturally, he put his hands in front of him to prevent Zhang San from repeating the same trick.
And as long as he successfully holds back Zhang San, the other two people will definitely be able to launch a pincer attack on Zhang San after they get up. It is not impossible to defeat Zhang San by then.
But Zhang San was rushing over with his body bent, and he was sprinting very fast. When the tall and thin boy raised his hand, he was less than half a foot away from the opponent.
The tall and thin boy had no choice but to form claws with his hands, trying to grab Zhang San's clothes or hair to make him stop.
However, Zhang San sank his legs and half knelt on the ground, changed the height again, and let the tall and thin boy's prepared attack fall into the air. Then he pressed his hands on the opponent's thighs, and pushed back, making the tall and thin boy who had just stopped and still not gain his footing fall backwards.
However, the tall and thin boy did not fall down directly. He swung his hands on both sides like a duck twice, and he finally regained his balance.
However, the tall and thin boy did not expect that Zhang San had already stood up at this time, and directly reached out to grab his extended right hand and threw him over his shoulder.
Of course, it is not appropriate to call it an "over-the-shoulder fall". Zhang San did not use so much force, but relied on the forward leaning force used by the opponent to prevent him from falling backward, and threw him forward.
"Get out of the way!"
Now the tall and thin boy really couldn't defend himself. He stumbled forward, and in his path were his two companions who were about to get up.
"Let's go there together!"
Just when the tall and thin boy was still trying to control his balance, Zhang San raised his eyebrows and kicked him on the butt.
"Uh-huh!"
As you can imagine, the three of them let out a scream and fell together.
Of course, these three people all have beast martial souls, and they are all still possessed by martial souls. Therefore, although they were smashed to pieces after falling to the ground, they actually did not lose their fighting power. As long as they got up, they could still compete with Zhang Sanyi.
But how could Zhang San give them this opportunity?
Facing the three people who were each making moves, Zhang San quickly stepped forward and kicked the tall, thin boy who was about to get up on the back, trampling him back directly.
Another short and weak boy with Plum Blossom Leopard Martial Spirit wanted to turn over and escape, but before he could turn over, Zhang San was punched in the head, and he was hit so hard that stars appeared in his eyes.
The fat boy who was pressed down by the tall and thin boy had already recovered. Lying on the ground, he wanted to imitate Zhang San and pull Zhang San's feet to create a counterattack for his companions.Chance.
